summary: Frontend-only verification of PREVIEW environment warning banners (login + admin shell) at desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844) viewports, plus regression spot-check of iteration_4 create-user flow. 22/22 assertions passed. Both banners render correctly only on preview (IS_PRODUCTION_BACKEND=false), link href is exactly https://quantumtv.app/login on both banners, banner sits ABOVE the sticky header on every admin page, does not overlap the mobile hamburger, does not cause horizontal scroll, and persists while modals are open. Create-user regression flow (open modal -> fill form -> submit -> success view -> Done -> card appears) still works end-to-end. Test user was created and cleaned up via /api/admin/users.
